_doc: Support layers of the static (Infinigen) furniture: the boards objects are placed on, checked by eye against each furniture's rendered mesh. Per furniture, layer name -> approximate height (m) of the rendered board top; tools/fit_support_repairs.py snaps it to the board (+-2 cm), lays an invisible collider slab on it (/World/SupportRepairs/<furniture>__<layer>) and lowers the furniture's collision mesh below every slab, and tools/annotate_scene.py turns each slab into the support <furniture>/<layer>. shelf_0 is the lowest board, then shelf_1 ...; top is the uppermost board when it is in reach. Left out: furniture nothing is placed on (beds and bedding, pillows, plant pots, ovens, dishwashers, toilets, sinks, towels), closed cabinet interiors of the kitchen counters, and boards above the robot's reach (planner prefilter: z < 1.5 m).
